paite: TOUPA phat un, Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah lah ahoih ngal a, azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi.
heading: Amite Tung A TOUPA Hoihna

paite: Kua ahia TOUPA thilhih thupitakte gen thei a, aphatnate theisak vek thei?
Vaihawmna kemhoihte'n nuam asa uhi, chik lai peuh a diktattak a hihmi toh.
TOUPA aw, na mite na deihsakna in hon theigige inla, Aw, na hotdamna toh hong veh in.
Na mitelte hamphatna ka muh theih a, na namte kipahna a nop ka sak theih a, na gouluahte toh ka suantheihna ding in.
Ka pipute uh bang in thil ka hihkhial ua, tatsetak ka hi ua, giloutak in ka om uhi.
Ka pipute un Aigupta gam a na thillamdang hihte atheisiam kei ua; na zahngaihna thupitak atheigige nawn kei ua, tuipi ah ahel zawta uh; Tuipi San ah.
Huchi pipi in leng ama min ziak in amaute ahondamta a, athilhihtheihna thupitak atheihsakna ding in.
Tuipi San atai a, huchi in akangta a; huan amau gamdai a pi paisuak bang in tui thukte ah api paisuakta hi.
Amau homi khut a kipan ahondam a, melma khut a kipan atanta hi.
Tuite'n amau doute akhuh khin a, khat leng dam a pawt a- omta kei uhi.
Huai lai in athute agingta ua; aphatna la asa uhi.
Himahleh athilhihte amangngilh zok ua; alunggelna angak ngamta kei uhi;
gamdai ah thil alunggulh mahmah ua, gamkeu ah Pathian aze-etta uhi.
Athilnget uh apia a; himahleh ahinna uah gawnna alutsakta hi.
Agiahphual uah Mosi ahaza ua, TOUPA misiangthou Aaron toh.
Lei akamka a, Dathan avalhta, Abiram pawlte akhuh khin hi.
Apawl lak uah mei kuansak in ahong om a, meikuang ah migilou-saloute akangmang uhi.
Horeb tang ah bawngnou lim abawl ua, alim sun abeta uhi.
Huchibang in athupina uh bawngtal loupa ne bang phet asuaksakta uhi.
Pathian ahondampa uh, Aigupta gam a thil thupitak hihpa amangngilhta uhi.
Ham gam a thillamdangte, Tuipi San dung a thil mulkimhuaite hihte.
Huaiziak in ahihmang kha ding, achi a, ahehna heimang ding in alutna ding ah ama ah amitel Mosi na dingh kei ngialleh, ahihmang ding chih agen hi.
Ahi, gam deihhuaitak angaineu ua, athu agingta nuam kei ua;
apuanin uah aphun zaw ua, TOUPA aw angaikhe nuam kei uhi.
Huaiziak in amau lam ah akhut azak a, amaute gamdai a ahihpukna ding leh,
achisuan dingte uh namte lak a ahihpuk a, gam chih a ahihzakna ding in.
Baal-peor azom ua, misi kiang a thillatte ane samta uhi.
Huchibang in athilhihte un amah asuheh ua; atung uah hipi aleng hi.
Phinehas adingh a, vai ahawm a; huchi in hipi daihsak in a- omta hi.
Huai amah diktatna a seh ahi, tangtawn in suan tengteng tan in.
Meribah tuite ah amah ahihheh ua, amau ziak in Mosi tung ah thil hoih lou atung hial hi.
Akha tung ah ahel ua, amuk in thu kilawmloupi agen ziak in.
TOUPA'N akiang ua hihman thu apiak bang in namte ahihmang kei ua.
Namte akihelpih ua, athilhihte uh aching zaw ua;
amilim nnate uh asem ua; huaite amau a ding in thang ahong hita hi.
Ahi, dawite kiang ah atapate leh atanute un akithoih ua,
sisan gensiatbei, atapate uleh atanute uh sisan asuah ua, huaite in Kanaan gam milimte kiang ah akithoih uhi; huai gam sisan in ana ninta hi.
Huchi in anasepte un ahihnin ua, athilhihte un ang a kawm uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA amite tung ah athangpaita a, agouluah akih hi.
Huchi in namte khut ah amau apia a; amau hote'n atung uah vai ahawm uhi.
Amau doute'n anuaisiah ua, akhut uah hihneu in a-om uhi.
Tamveipi amaute ahumbit a; himahleh alunggelna uah ahel nak uhi, agitlouh satlouhna uah hihniam in a-omta uhi.
Huchipi in leng ama'n, akikou husa uh za in, amangbatna uh alimsak ahi.
Athukhun amau atheisak gige a, azahngaihna thupidan bang zel in alungsim akisikta hi.
Sal a pi tengteng amau ahehpihsak hi.
TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, hon hondam inla, namte lak a pan hon pikhawm in, na min siangthou phat ding leh na phatna suang ding in.
TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, phat in om hen, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in leng, mi tengteng in, Amen, chi uhen, TOUPA phat un.
